name: PROVING GROUND
intro: Bank boost, launch the gold lanes, and smash every marked cone.

design.focus: Recombine Race School skills in six readable boost-to-air cycles before adding moving rivals.
design.pacing: A welcoming opening grows through hills, dirt, lane-choice jumps, and airbrake precision, breathes after every technical pair, then rebuilds into a fast downhill finish.
design.targetTuning: PROVISIONAL: 3342 segments create a 55.7-second theoretical floor at 12000 world units/second. The 78-second qualifier adds 40 percent for acceleration, two dirt sectors, curves, elevation, and one recoverable mistake. Replace it with the median of five clean telemetry runs plus a 10-15 percent completion allowance.

cycles.summary: Learn the Story rhythm on open asphalt before the first broad rival passing zone.
cycles.flow: Long read, center boost, painted ramp, open landing, five-cone smash sweep, broad recovery.
cycles.safeLine: Skip the boost and pass the ramp on either open shoulder, leaving the optional cone sweep for a replay.
cycles.committedLine: Bank the center boost, launch the painted lane, settle for the cone sweep, then recenter for the fast exit.

cycles.summary: Climb into an honest straight-runway jump, then spend speed through a compact chicane.
cycles.flow: Visible climb, boost, straight ramp, controlled landing, chicane lane switch, five-cone payoff, recovery.
cycles.safeLine: Climb without spending boost, take the ordinary jump arc, and brake before the chicane.
cycles.committedLine: Spend boost for the longer arc, recenter on landing, and airbrake through the chicane into the cone chain.

cycles.summary: Use a dirt launch to escape drag, then rebuild speed through a paved sweeper.
cycles.flow: Dirt read, stored boost, ramp, air choice onto clean road, open-lane rock formation, paved curve, long breath.
cycles.safeLine: Stay grounded beside the dirt ramp and take the left lane around the authored rocks.
cycles.committedLine: Launch out of the dirt, hold the arc onto asphalt, and carry the recovered speed through the sweeper.

cycles.summary: Make the first explicit ground-versus-air choice before a stronger opposing bend.
cycles.flow: Uphill boost, ramp-over-rocks choice, rewarding landing, broad curve, straight recovery and rival passing zone.
cycles.safeLine: Ignore the ramp lane and keep one of the two clear ground lanes through the rock payload.
cycles.committedLine: Boost up the painted lane, glide over its rocks, then land early enough to set the opposing curve.

cycles.summary: Link a loose-surface jump to the course's strongest left-right airbrake test.
cycles.flow: Dirt bend, boost, ramp, asphalt landing reward, sharper chicane, five-cone transfer, clean release.
cycles.safeLine: Use the outside dirt lane, skip the launch, and enter the chicane below overspeed.
cycles.committedLine: Launch from dirt, claim the landing boost, then trade a little speed to sweep the objective cones.

cycles.summary: Rebuild the music and speed through the fastest final descent without hiding the finish.
cycles.flow: Strong curve read, boost, ramp-over-rocks choice, long downhill flight and recovery, center-lane rock thread, clean finish runway.
cycles.safeLine: Stay outside the ramp lane, thread the open ground response, and descend under control.
cycles.committedLine: Spend the final boost over the rock bed, hold the downhill arc, then airbrake to center for the last thread.
